newsitem.title: USA: Fingerhut system error hurt collections.
newsitem.headline: Fingerhut system error hurt collections.

text.p: Fingerhut Cos Inc said Tuesday a systems error, discovered in the third quarter, was responsible for suspending collection of 600,000 accounts, contributing to higher delinquency levels.

The company said in a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission that the start-up of a new collections center during the quarter may have reduced the overall effectiveness of collection efforts.

The direct-marketing company said its provision for uncollectible accounts in the third quarter was $58.2 million, or 16.9 percent of sales, compared with $58.4 million, or 14.9 percent, in the corresponding period a year ago.

"While management has responded with aggressive collection efforts to minimize bad debt exposure, should the higher delinquency persist, additional provisions for uncollectible accounts, which could be material, will be required," the company said in the filing.
Fingerhut shares closed 2-5/8 lower at 11-3/4 on the New York Stock Exchange Tuesday, on volume of 1.2 million shares.
